title: Rigatoni di Gregorio

items: 1 lb chicken breast, cut into 1 to 1½-inch pieces
1 Tbsp fresh basil, chopped (and parsley mix)
Additional parsley and Parmesan shavings, for garnish

steps: Heat the olive oil over medium-low heat and caramelize the onion.
In a large pot, sauté the mushrooms with the balsamic vinegar until the liquid is released and reabsorbed.
Add the onion, chicken and garlic to the mushrooms; season with salt and pepper.
Add chicken stock, Marsala and white wine. Bring to a boil and simmer until reduced by half.
Add cream, bring to a boil and simmer until slightly thickened.
While the sauce thickens, cook the rigatoni just shy of al dente; it will cook a little more in the sauce.
Drain the pasta, add to the sauce and toss with basil, parsley, Parmesan and garlic butter. Season with salt and pepper to taste and garnish with parsley and Parmesan shavings.
